import io
p = 'sklearn/model_selection/_search.py'
s = io.open(p, encoding='utf-8').read()

# 1. import time
old_imp = "import operator\nimport warnings\n"
assert old_imp in s
s = s.replace(old_imp, "import operator\nimport warnings\nfrom time import time\n", 1)

# 2. measure refit time
old_refit = """        if self.refit:
            self.best_estimator_ = clone(base_estimator).set_params(
                **self.best_params_)
            if y is not None:
                self.best_estimator_.fit(X, y, **fit_params)
            else:
                self.best_estimator_.fit(X, **fit_params)
"""
new_refit = """        if self.refit:
            self.best_estimator_ = clone(base_estimator).set_params(
                **self.best_params_)
            refit_start_time = time()
            if y is not None:
                self.best_estimator_.fit(X, y, **fit_params)
            else:
                self.best_estimator_.fit(X, **fit_params)
            refit_end_time = time()
            self.refit_time_ = refit_end_time - refit_start_time
"""
assert s.count(old_refit) == 1
s = s.replace(old_refit, new_refit, 1)

# 3. document attribute in both GridSearchCV and RandomizedSearchCV docstrings
old_doc = """    best_index_ : int
        The index (of the ``cv_results_`` arrays) which corresponds to the best
        candidate parameter setting.
"""
new_doc = """    refit_time_ : float
        Seconds used for refitting the best model on the whole dataset.

        This is present only if ``refit`` is not False.

    best_index_ : int
        The index (of the ``cv_results_`` arrays) which corresponds to the best
        candidate parameter setting.
"""
count = s.count(old_doc)
print('doc occurrences:', count)
assert count == 2
s = s.replace(old_doc, new_doc)

io.open(p, 'w', encoding='utf-8').write(s)
print('patched')
EOF
